payload.title: Time Semantics
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to handle time series data using Pandas and Pyleoclim. It involves loading CO2 concentration data from an Excel file, converting time columns to datetime format, and creating Pandas and Pyleoclim Series objects. The notebook also covers plotting these series and performing spectral analysis using the Lomb-Scargle method. The focus is on manipulating time intervals and visualizing data effectively.
